newsitem.title: USA: Rouse to redevelop Bethlehem Steel site.
newsitem.headline: Rouse to redevelop Bethlehem Steel site.

text.p: The site of the Bethlehem, Pa., structural products mill Bethlehem Steel Corp is closing will become part of a redevelopment effort being undertaken by a Rouse Co subsidiary, Bethlehem Steel spokesman Art Roth said.
The mill has been producing I and H beams for the construction industry since 1908, Roth said.
The company announced Thursday it had been unable to find a buyer for the mill and had given the United Steelworkers of America the required 90 day notice of the mill's closing.
It continues to try to sell the assets of the rolling mill, Roth said.
